subject: StratusPay inference upgrade — output surge, latency & error spike
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@stratuspay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production regression after v3.2/quant P8

Rachel —

We pushed Redwood model v3.2 with quant profile P8 last night (2027-05-02 01:05 UTC) to our production traffic and immediately started seeing a spike in latency and an increase in malformed outputs. Key findings from our side: p95 latency jumped from ~320ms to ~1.8s, p99 occasionally breaching 4.5s, and ~2.7% of requests returning truncated or garbled text (examples attached). This is impacting credit-card tokenization flows that need low tail latency.

Can you confirm whether the quant profile change rolled through a fallback or variant routing? We need a mitigation plan ASAP — customers are seeing timeouts and degraded UX.

I can be on a call in 20 minutes.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform Engineering, StratusPay
alex@stratuspay.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.2/quant P8

Alex — thanks for the quick heads-up and the examples. I’m very sorry you’re seeing this. I’ve looped in Marcus (serving/runtime), Lauren (CS lead), and Sergio (AM) so we can respond immediately.

Immediate actions we’re kicking off now:
- Marcus is triaging hot traces and will evaluate rollback to v3.1 variant if needed.
- We’ll route StratusPay traffic to the prior quant profile variant (v3.1/P6) as a hot fallback while we investigate.
- CS will prepare customer-facing comms and monitor user-impact.

Please hold any other automation rollouts. We’ll aim to have a mitigation update within 60 minutes. I’ll start a short bridge: meet.redwood.ai/stratus-triage (10 min).

Apologies again — we’ll own the fix.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex@stratuspay.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.2/quant P8 — initial triage

On 2027-05-02 08:30 PDT Rachel Kim wrote:
> Please hold any other automation rollouts. We’ll aim to have a mitigation update within 60 minutes.

Quick triage notes from runtime team (hot):
- Confirmed correlation: rollout of v3.2 with quant P8 coincides with traffic shift at 2027-05-02T01:05Z.
- Symptom set: p95 ↑ ~5x, p99 ↑ ~10–12x on certain hot endpoints (tokenizer-heavy long-prefix calls); error-rate attributable to decoder OOM/partial output ~2–3%.
- Root cues: new kernel selection path for P8 is falling back to a slower emulation on a small set of sequence lengths; additionally KV cache prefetch logic under P8 appears to increase memory locality misses leading to stalls.

Immediate mitigation plan I’m executing now:
1) Hot fallback: switching StratusPay route to pinned model variant v3.1/P6 (no quant change). This will be live in ~7–12 minutes.
2) Canary pause: pausing further v3.2/P8 canaries in the US region.
3) Collecting full traces (uploading error_trace_v3.2.log) and assembling a p99 report (p99_report_StratusPay_20270502.pdf).
4) If fallback doesn’t stabilize within 20 minutes, we’ll spin temporary extra GPU capacity in the dedicated pool to reduce queuing while we debug.

I’ll post updates to INF-7123 and share the initial trace bundle to the Drive link.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.2/quant P8 — customer update

Hi Alex —

Thanks for reporting this and for the sample payloads. First, apologies to your users — this is not the experience we intend to deliver. We’ve enacted the following:
- Traffic is being routed to the prior stable variant (v3.1/P6) as of 10:15 PDT. Early telemetry shows p95 dropping back toward baseline for the affected endpoints.
- Marcus’s team has pushed the trace bundle and we’ve attached the initial p99 report for your review (p99_report_StratusPay_20270502.pdf).
- We’re preparing a short post-mortem that will include a timeline, root cause, and remedial actions (config hardening + canary gating).

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-minute post-mortem call at 11:00 PDT to review findings and agree on rollback/patch cadence.
2) If you need an SLA credit or contract amendment check, please loop Priya Desai in procurement.

We’ll keep the bridge open and will send a follow-up within the hour confirming stabilization.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Lead — Strategic Accounts
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: StratusPay production regression — exec summary for awareness

Aditya — forwarding the incident thread so leadership has visibility. Short exec summary below for status and ask: 

Summary: Model upgrade (v3.2 + quant P8) rolled to StratusPay at 01:05Z produced a latency and partial-output spike observed across several hot endpoints used by their payment tokenization flow. Immediate routing to v3.1/P6 is live and early telemetry looks stabilizing.
Impact: Customer-facing performance degradation (p99 spikes to ~4–5s), ~2–3% malformed outputs, high user-visible timeouts during peak. Potential revenue impact for StratusPay merchant flows if not fully remediated quickly.
Ask: Exec awareness and approval for two actions if needed — (1) temporary capacity bump on Dedicated pool for StratusPay (we can absorb cost for 72 hours if it expedites recovery), (2) priority engineering allocation for a short-term patch to P8 path (Marcus estimates ~3 engineer-days).

I’ve attached the trace bundle and p99 summary. Please advise; Rachel can coordinate comms.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive — Payments
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@stratuspay.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T18:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.2/quant P8 — mitigation complete and next steps

Alex —

Follow-up to close the loop: we completed the hot-fallback to the previous stable variant (v3.1/P6) and validated traffic continues to show baseline latency and error rates for tokenization paths. Key notes: 
- p95 now ~340–360ms, p99 ~420–520ms on sampled windows (attached p99_report_StratusPay_20270502.pdf).
- No additional malformed-output reports after fallback.
- Marcus’s team has a fix candidate for the P8 kernel selection and KV-locality regression; we will not reintroduce P8 to StratusPay until that patch passes a stricter canary gate across sequence-length distribution.

Planned deliverables and timeline: 
1) Hotfix for P8 kernel logic and KV prefetch: engineering ETA 3 business days (we will target an expedited rollback/process if needed sooner).
2) Post-mortem and RCA doc (will include mitigation hardening and canary checklist) — draft by 2027-05-05.
3) If you want us to run an extended stability test in a restricted window, we’ll coordinate with your platform team; we’ll also offer a one-time service credit as goodwill per the contract (SOW_StratusPay_v2.pdf attached).

Again, apologies — we own this. Thank you for the rapid detection and sample payloads; they were immensely helpful.

If you’d like a quick executive sync tomorrow, I can schedule time with Aditya.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
